cases.trustedProxy: selects the client before the configured trusted proxy hops
cases.invalidIdentity: uses the anonymous identity when forwarding data is invalid
cases.window: resets the counter after the authored window
cases.timeout: fails closed when the provider times out
cases.unavailable: fails closed when the provider rejects
cases.concurrent: shares one atomic limit across independent app instances
cases.databaseWindow: resets the shared bucket after the authored window
cases.login: authenticates through the real login route
cases.logout: clears the session through the real logout route
cases.signup: creates an identity through the real signup route
cases.duplicate: rejects duplicate signup through the real route
cases.limited: blocks the configured login route after the shared limit
cases.misconfigured: fails the real auth route closed when its provider is unconfigured
